newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge up amid OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge up amid OMO.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates surged on Wednesday amid an open market operation in which dealers said the central bank had picked up substantial amounts.
Onvernight funds were initially offered at 10 percent as the market was expecting the central bank to mop up a heavy amount in the operation, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.

The rates soon moved up to 14 percent, were pushed up further by reports that the central bank had accepted bids in the open market operation and closing deals were seen in the range of 19 and 20 percent, he said.
He said the market ended short and banks tapped the discount window of the central bank to square their positions.
The rates are likely to remain high as the central bank has announced to hold another open market operation on Thursday, dealers said. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
